name: math-tactical-classroom-v60-factorization
description: Offline Math Tactical classroom Windows installer based on the validated V60 five-room engine, with fast 1–2 hit normal enemies, the preserved Room 5 final boss, five procedural factorization cases, controlled pauses, encrypted PIN-protected local results, and an isolated application data vault.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-classroom-v60.js && node scripts/patch-v60-factorization-workshop.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v60/main.js && node --check school-game/v60/preload.js && node --check school-game/v60/game.js && node scripts/math-factorization-v60-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dir:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
